passages.title: Judicial Proceedings and Victim Protection in the Municipal Court
passages.titleVi: Tố tụng tư pháp và bảo vệ nạn nhân tại tòa án thành phố
passages.text: In modern democratic legal systems, the municipal courthouse operates under strict procedural protocols to uphold constitutional justice, preserve civil order, and protect public safety. Whenever a serious criminal offense occurs within the district, law enforcement investigators gather physical evidence to establish whether the harmful act was intentional or purely accidental. During an important morning court trial yesterday, the presiding magistrate listened attentively as the state prosecutor presented detailed forensic reports and surveillance recordings. Soon afterward, the primary eyewitness was summoned forward to swear a solemn oath that she would speak only the absolute truth before the judicial assembly. With steady composure, the witness recounted how the masked suspect brandished a dangerous weapon to issue an intimidating threat against defenseless neighborhood shopkeepers. Because the perpetrator willfully disregarded an explicit verbal warning from responding patrol officers, municipal security teams intervened swiftly to disarm him and neutralize the volatile confrontation. Throughout the preliminary hearing, appointed defense lawyers worked diligently to defend their client and examine procedural fairness, while victim assistance coordinators ensured that the vulnerable crime victim received continuous legal support and trauma counseling. To safeguard judicial proceedings against outside intimidation or retaliation, court marshals maintained a completely secure perimeter across all public corridors and entrances. In delivering the interim ruling, the magistrate emphasized that every statutory preventative measure enforced by the city serves to protect law-abiding families from lawless violence. By balancing compassionate care for victims with rigorous criminal accountability, the justice system firmly reaffirms that civil peace and fairness must prevail for all citizens.

passages.title: Upholding Justice and the Rule of Law
passages.titleVi: Thượng tôn công lý và nhà nước pháp quyền
passages.text: Detective Marcus arrived at headquarters early to oversee an ongoing criminal investigation. A high-profile incident occurred downtown over the weekend, involving an armed burglary at a commercial currency exchange. Forensic specialists discovered a spent bullet casing near the shattered entrance, but confirmed that the security guards remained unarmed throughout the encounter to ensure public safety. Following departmental policy, officers interviewed witnesses and reviewed surveillance footage to track down the primary suspect. After hours of meticulous detective work, prosecutors finalized a formal indictment against two individuals. However, the legal counsel reminded the court that every defendant is presumed innocent until proven guilty beyond a reasonable doubt. The national constitution guarantees fundamental protection for all citizens, ensuring that evidence is legally gathered and examined with absolute impartiality. During the preliminary hearing, judges verified the validity of digital search warrants before admitting them into public record. Community leaders and local journalists followed the proceedings closely from the gallery. They acknowledged that fair judicial processes strengthen public trust in civic institutions and safeguard order across the entire municipality. Outside the courthouse, citizens expressed relief that the case had been resolved transparently without civil unrest. Transparent trials demonstrate that the law applies equally to all members of society regardless of their social rank or wealth. By maintaining rigorous integrity, the judicial system reaffirms its sacred duty to protect human dignity. Fair legal procedures and accessible legal aid ensure that even the most vulnerable individuals receive an impartial hearing. Ultimately, equal justice under the law remains the cornerstone of lasting peace.

Chú ý nối âm tự nhiên giữa phụ âm và nguyên âm tiếp theo trong 'presumed innocent' (/prɪˈzumd ˈɪnəsənt/) và 'legally gathered and' (/ˈliɡəli ˈɡæðərd ænd/).
Từ 'constitution' gồm 4 âm tiết (/ˌkɑːn.stəˈtuː.ʃən/) với trọng âm chính đặt ở âm tiết thứ ba (-tu-).
Giọng đọc trang nghiêm, ngữ điệu hạ rõ ở cuối câu và giữ khoảng dừng dứt khoát sau các trạng từ đầu câu như 'However,' hoặc 'Outside the courthouse,'.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Why did the security guards remain unarmed during the downtown incident?
options: To prioritize and ensure public safety during the confrontation
Because their weapons had been seized by foreign hackers
They forgot the access codes to the facility's ammunition bunker
Company policy prohibited all forms of electronic identification
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn văn nêu rõ các nhân viên bảo vệ không mang vũ khí để đảm bảo an toàn cho công chúng ('the security guards remained unarmed throughout the encounter to ensure public safety').

comprehensionQuestions.question: What core constitutional principle did the legal counsel emphasize in court?
options: Every defendant is presumed innocent until proven guilty beyond reasonable doubt
All trials must conclude within forty-eight hours regardless of evidence
Only government officials are permitted to inspect digital warrants
Criminal defendants must cover all legal expenses of the prosecution
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Luật sư bào chữa nhắc nhở tòa án nguyên tắc hiến pháp: mọi bị cáo được suy đoán vô tội cho đến khi bị chứng minh có tội ('every defendant is presumed innocent until proven guilty beyond a reasonable doubt').

comprehensionQuestions.question: What did the judges verify during the preliminary hearing before admitting records?
options: The legal validity of the digital search warrants
The personal background of all journalists in the gallery
The total monetary value of stolen foreign currency notes
The exact manufacturing date of the recovered bullet casing
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Trong phiên điều trần sơ bộ, các thẩm phán đã xác minh tính hiệu lực của các lệnh khám xét kỹ thuật số ('verified the validity of digital search warrants').

passages.title: Judicial Evidence and Legal Integrity: Evaluating Public Testimony and Security in Criminal Trials
passages.titleVi: Chứng cứ tư pháp và tính toàn vẹn pháp lý: Đánh giá lời khai trước tòa và an ninh trong các vụ án hình sự
passages.text: Maintaining public order and protecting citizens requires a robust legal system that strictly adheres to the rule of law. When an armed robber caused widespread panic during a dangerous store rampage downtown, local police officers immediately initiated an extensive criminal investigation. Modern detectives rely heavily on advanced surveillance recordings and physical clues to validate important facts before presenting a formal indictment in court. In this critical trial, detectives examined electronic footage very precisely to verify every single second of the suspect's movements. A respected municipal judge presided over the formal courtroom proceedings, ensuring that both prosecutors and defense attorneys behaved with complete professional integrity. During the hearing, an eyewitness offered detailed testimony about a suspicious vehicle that had stopped near the bank shortly before the incident occurred. However, cautious defense lawyers initially approached the witness account with understandable skepticism, demanding additional objective verification. Fortunately, forensic specialists were able to correlate the eyewitness statements reliably with high-resolution digital timestamps. The courtroom atmosphere served as a powerful reminder of how judicial safeguards protect innocent citizens while holding dangerous offenders accountable. By strictly following statutory procedures, the court validated all forensic evidence and delivered a balanced and transparent verdict. Citizens who attended the trial gained renewed confidence that legal standards reliably safeguard individual liberties against injustice. Every criminal trial demonstrates that community safety depends on impartial judges, thorough investigators, and honest citizens working together to preserve fairness. When citizens trust the integrity of their legal institutions, local communities flourish with shared respect, mutual cooperation, and lasting peace for generations to come.

sentencePairs.en: Maintaining public order and protecting citizens requires a robust legal system that strictly adheres to the rule of law.
sentencePairs.vi: Duy trì trật tự công cộng và bảo vệ người dân đòi hỏi một hệ thống pháp luật vững chắc tuân thủ nghiêm ngặt nguyên tắc pháp quyền.

sentencePairs.vi: Trong phiên tòa quan trọng này, các điều tra viên đã kiểm tra các đoạn phim điện tử một cách vô cùng chính xác để xác minh từng giây di chuyển của nghi phạm.

sentencePairs.en: Fortunately, forensic specialists were able to correlate the eyewitness statements reliably with high-resolution digital timestamps.
sentencePairs.vi: May mắn thay, các chuyên gia pháp y đã có thể liên hệ các lời khai của nhân chứng một cách đáng tin cậy với các mốc thời gian kỹ thuật số độ phân giải cao.

sentencePairs.vi: Bầu không khí phòng xử án đóng vai trò như một lời nhắc nhở sâu sắc về cách các biện pháp bảo vệ tư pháp bảo vệ công dân vô tội trong khi buộc những kẻ phạm tội nguy hiểm phải chịu trách nhiệm.

sentencePairs.en: By strictly following statutory procedures, the court validated all forensic evidence and delivered a balanced and transparent verdict.

sentencePairs.en: Every criminal trial demonstrates that community safety depends on impartial judges, thorough investigators, and honest citizens working together to preserve fairness.
sentencePairs.vi: Mỗi phiên tòa hình sự đều chứng minh rằng sự an toàn của cộng đồng phụ thuộc vào các thẩm phán công tâm, các điều tra viên kỹ lưỡng và những công dân trung thực cùng hợp tác để gìn giữ sự công bằng.

sentencePairs.en: When citizens trust the integrity of their legal institutions, local communities flourish with shared respect, mutual cooperation, and lasting peace for generations to come.

pronunciationNotesVi: Âm đuôi /s/ và /z/: Phân biệt âm gió trong 'witness' (/ˈwɪtnəs/ - vô thanh) và 'citizens' (/ˈsɪtɪzənz/ - hữu thanh).
Trọng âm từ 'testimony' (/ˈtɛstəˌmoʊni/): Nhấn mạnh vào âm tiết thứ nhất 'tes-', các âm tiết sau hạ giọng nhẹ.
Âm xát vòm vô thanh /ʃ/ trong 'suspicious' (/səˈspɪʃəs/) và 'crucial' (/ˈkɹuʃəl/): Tròn môi và đẩy hơi dứt khoát.
Trọng âm từ 'surveillance' (/sɚˈveɪləns/): Nhấn vào âm tiết thứ hai '-veil-', âm đầu là nguyên âm nhẹ /sɚ-/.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What essential role did electronic surveillance recordings play in the criminal trial?
options: They enabled detectives to precisely examine and validate the suspect's movements.
They replaced the need for any courtroom testimony or judicial rulings.
They caused the defense attorneys to immediately surrender without questioning.
They were dismissed completely due to unresolvable camera errors.
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Bài đọc nêu rõ rằng các điều tra viên đã kiểm tra các đoạn phim điện tử một cách vô cùng chính xác để xác minh từng chuyển động của nghi phạm.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Why did defense lawyers initially express skepticism regarding the eyewitness testimony?
options: They wanted additional objective verification before accepting the witness account.
The witness refused to identify the suspicious vehicle observed outside.
The judge had strictly barred all witness accounts from being presented.
The testimony contradicted all physical timestamps collected downtown.
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Bài đọc cho biết các luật sư bào chữa ban đầu tiếp cận lời kể của nhân chứng bằng sự hoài nghi dễ hiểu và yêu cầu xác minh khách quan bổ sung.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What fundamental message does the courtroom trial convey about community justice?
options: Legal safeguards, honest witnesses, and impartial judges reliably preserve safety and fairness.
Criminal trials should rely entirely on subjective rumors rather than forensic clues.
Judges ought to bypass statutory procedures to deliver rapid verdicts.
Communities can achieve lasting peace only when electronic cameras are eliminated.
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Bài đọc nhấn mạnh rằng an toàn cộng đồng phụ thuộc vào các thẩm phán công tâm, nhà điều tra kỹ lưỡng và các biện pháp bảo vệ tư pháp bảo vệ công lý một cách đáng tin cậy.
